answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the meadow accrues. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its violet from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the lotus expensive rather than free. Seal 1h8l9.
